lines.text: The psalm gives glory to the LORD's name, and says our God is in heaven and does as He pleases.
The nations' idols are made of silver and gold by human hands, yet they cannot speak, see, or hear.
Those who make idols become like them, while Israel, the house of Aaron, and those who fear the LORD are told to trust Him.
The LORD will bless Israel and the house of Levi, and the blessing comes from the Maker of heaven and earth.
The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but He has given the earth to priests, and the living will bless Him forevermore.
